# Licences a pinned package may carry, as SPDX identifiers, one per line.
#
# A package whose Appendix B row names a licence outside this list fails the
# build, and every part of a multi-part row has to be here. A row used to pass
# when either half was, on the reasoning that a dual licence is a choice the
# consumer makes — but the gate reads a `/` and cannot tell a disjunction from
# a conjunction, so under that rule a forbidden licence clears itself by
# arriving in the company of an allowed one. Where a package really is offered
# under either, the row names the half this repository takes. That is the
# decision the gate exists to force rather than absorb.
#
# A spelling the gate cannot map to an identifier fails differently and says
# so. Adding a line here is the repair for a licence that was read and refused;
# it is never the repair for one that was never read.
#
# Adding a line is a decision about every future dependency, not about the one
# in front of you. It belongs in an ADR.
